patch_description: Add exact constraint derivatives and replace the final SLSQP radius allocation by the fixed-center linear-program optimum. The geometric optimization determines a contact graph, but its terminating radius vector is often not the best allocation on that graph: the LP can deliberately shrink a poorly placed boundary disk and distribute the released clearance to several neighbors. Analytic derivatives make the existing multistart optimization more reliable and leave ample time for a short second polish from that LP-optimal allocation. The strict existing common-scale polish remains the final validity certificate.
